bugs.why: When the buffered data is an exact multiple of chunk_size, remainder is 0 and `value[-0:]` is the whole buffer, so all already-returned bytes are re-buffered and emitted again.

agent.explanation: When remainder is 0 (i.e. len(value) is an exact multiple of chunk_size), value[-0:] evaluates to value[:] instead of b''. This writes the entire buffer back into self._buffer instead of clearing it, causing all data to be retained and re-emitted in subsequent calls.
